title: pvLevelScalarsOverlappingAMR
body:
## pvLevelScalarsOverlappingAMR

Adds an array named LevelIdScalars holding the refinement level of each block of an overlapping AMR dataset, so refinement levels can be coloured or thresholded. The input must be vtkOverlappingAMR (e.g. from AMR readers); structure is unchanged. This is the old name of the same ParaView filter.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ParaView 5.13 marks this proxy deprecated (renamed OverlappingAMRLevelIds, removal planned for 5.14); use pvOverlappingAMRLevelIds, which has the same behaviour and settings.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `LevelScalarsOverlappingAMR`. Identity: `filters/OverlappingLevelIdScalars`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Level Scalars filter. Accepted data: overlapping AMR data (vtkOverlappingAMR). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkOverlappingAMR"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvLevelScalarsOverlappingAMR",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
